persona.title: Pretend you are…
persona.text: Pretend you are Mary, 42, in Ohio. You cook supper for your family: your mom and dad (they live with you now) and your son, Kevin. Every evening someone asks what is for supper, and every week you drive back to the store because you forgot something. Today you want to plan the week's suppers and make one shopping list.

challenge.intro: Now you are Mary in Ohio. The app must start empty. Nobody will tell you which button to press: use what you learned (the Level line at the top may matter). You do not need to send anything. When you finish, tap Check my work.
challenge.start: Use the NORMAL app link (not the 🧪 test copy). Open Our Table. 1) If the welcome tour shows by itself, tap 'skip the tour' → '✨ Start fresh with my own' → OK. 2) On the 📖 Recipes tab, scroll to the bottom and tap '🧹 Clear or start over…' → '🧹 Start over — clear everything' → OK. This clears every recipe, the week, the shopping list and the family names. The Recipes list is now empty. (New 13 Oct: Our Table v1.17 has this button; before, you had to delete things one by one.)

tasks.text: Put in three dinners your family really eats, each as its own recipe: Chili, Tacos, and Pot roast.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('dj_ourtable_v1')||'null');if(!d||!Array.isArray(d.recipes))return false;var W=['chili','tacos','pot roast'];var ns=d.recipes.filter(function(r){return !/\(example\)/i.test(String(r.name||''))}).map(function(r){return String(r.name||'').toLowerCase()});return W.every(function(w){return ns.some(function(n){return n.indexOf(w)>=0&&W.filter(function(x){return n.indexOf(x)>=0}).length===1})})}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Three dinners means three separate recipes, not one recipe with three names. Look on the Recipes tab.

tasks.text: Write down what you must buy for Pot roast: potatoes, beef, onions and carrots.
tasks.hint: Open the Pot roast recipe and tap Edit. The 'Ingredients' box takes one thing on each line.

tasks.text: Plan at least four nights of this week with your own dinners. Sunday must be Pot roast.
tasks.hint: Use the This week tab. Tap a night to choose a dinner. Check that Pot roast is on Sun, not Sat.

tasks.text: Put in who eats at your table: Mom, Dad and Kevin. Kevin does not like chili. Record that in the app.
tasks.hint: Names go in '👪 Family favorites' on the This week tab. Then open the Chili recipe and look under 'Who likes it?'.

tasks.text: Make the shopping list for this week's dinners, so the potatoes for Pot roast are on it. You also need paper towels: add them to the list.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('dj_ourtable_v1')||'null');if(!d)return false;var s=(d.shop||[]).some(function(x){return String(x.text||'').toLowerCase().indexOf('potato')>=0});var c=(d.extras||[]).some(function(x){return String(x.text||'').toLowerCase().indexOf('paper towels')>=0});return s&&c}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: The shopping list is made FROM the week, so plan Pot roast first. If you cannot see the Shopping tab, tap the Level line at the top.

tasks.text: You already have onions at home. Take the onions off the shopping list, but keep everything else on it.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('dj_ourtable_v1')||'null');if(!d||!Array.isArray(d.shop))return false;var P=d.pantry||{};var had=d.shop.some(function(x){return String(x.text||'').toLowerCase().indexOf('potato')>=0});var on=d.shop.some(function(x){return String(x.text||'').toLowerCase().indexOf('onion')>=0&&!P[x.key]});return had&&!on}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: On the 🧺 Shopping tab, each thing has an ✕ to take it off (or 🏠 Have it). If you take off the wrong thing, tap ↩︎ Undo.

ownWords.question: In your own words, what is this app for?
keyIdeas: keep the dinners your family really cooks, with what to buy for each
plan a dinner for each night of the week
it makes one shopping list from the whole week

lines: Welcome. In about four minutes, you will know what Our Table is for and how to use it.
First, the problem. Every evening: what's for dinner? And every week, another trip back to the store, because somebody forgot the onions.
Our Table answers both. You keep the dinners your family really cooks. You put one on each night of the week. Then the app makes one shopping list for the whole week.
Who is it for? Anyone who cooks for a household: a busy parent, a couple tired of deciding, a grandparent with the grandkids on Sundays.
Here is the layout. At the bottom are the tabs. Recipes is your list of dinners. This week is the seven nights. Shopping is the list for the store.
At the top, a green helper card suggests one next thing to do, with a button that does it.
Above it is your Level. Level one is recipes and the week. Level two adds the Shopping tab. Level three adds sharing. Tap it to change, any time. Nothing is lost.
Let's start on Recipes. To find a recipe, type part of its name, or an ingredient like beef, in the search box.
New recipe opens a blank recipe page.
Type the name. Pick a picture if you like. Then tap the tags that fit, like Quick or Sunday.
Under Ingredients, write what to buy, one thing on each line. These go on the shopping list. The rest is optional. Then tap Save.
In a hurry? The gold box, Put your own dinners in, takes just the names. You can add the ingredients later with Edit.
Recipes somewhere else? Bring your dinners over pastes them in from another app, a website or your notes.
Tap any recipe to open it. You see the ingredients and how to make it.
Made it tonight adds one to its count. Put it on a night adds it to this week. Edit changes it. Delete removes it, and asks first.
Cook shows the steps one at a time, in big letters, and keeps the screen on while you cook.
Now the This week tab. It shows the week, Monday to Sunday. Tap a night to pick its dinner.
Tap a recipe, or type your own words, like Pizza night. Leave blank empties the night.
Fill the blanks for me puts your dinners on the empty nights for you, favorites first. Clear the week empties all seven nights.
How many at the table? Change the number, and the shopping amounts grow or shrink to match.
In Family favorites, type who eats at your table. Tap Who likes it and pass the phone around: each person gives a dinner a heart or a thumbs down. Fill the blanks skips the thumbs downs.
When the week is planned, tap Build the shopping list.
Now the Shopping tab. The list joins the ingredients from every night and sorts them by the part of the store.
Tick things off as you buy them. Have it marks what is already in the cupboard. To add anything else, like paper towels, type it in the Add box.

Made a mistake? Every thing on the list has an ✕ to take it off. Remove the ticked ones and Clear the list are under the list. At the bottom of Recipes, Clear or start over can clear the week, the list, or everything. Each clear asks first, and Undo puts it back.
Text the list sends it to whoever is going to the store. Print gives you a paper copy.
How to start: type the names of three dinners you really cook, and tap Remove the three examples. Then put them on this week's nights.
Everything stays on this phone. There is no account and nothing to sign up for. Our Table is free.
The question mark button in the corner has the tour and help, any time.
And every Daraja app helps a student in Kenya stay in school. Enjoy your dinners.

daily.task: Plan tomorrow’s dinner in Our Table: put a meal on tomorrow (or change it), or add one item to the shopping list.

explore.name: 📖 Recipes
explore.find: Open Our Table. You start here.
explore.try: Search “beef”, then search “zzz”. Tap each kind button (Quick, Sunday…) and All.

explore.name: 🍲 One recipe
explore.try: Tap ✓ Made it tonight, 📅 Put it on a night, 👩‍🍳 Cook (go to the last step), and ❤️ / 👎 in Who likes it. Close.

explore.name: ✏️ The recipe page
explore.find: Tap ＋ New recipe, or ✏️ Edit on a recipe.
explore.try: Fill every box: name, picture, tags, ingredients, how to make it, time. Try Save with no name. Delete a recipe you made.

explore.name: 📥 Bring your dinners over
explore.try: Paste a few lines of any recipe and see what it makes. Try it with the box empty.

explore.name: 📅 This week
explore.find: Tap 📅 This week at the bottom.
explore.try: Tap an empty night and pick a recipe. On another night type your own words (tick “keep as a recipe”). Try 🔁 Swap, Clear and Leave blank.

explore.name: ✨ Week buttons
explore.try: Tap ✨ Fill the blanks, change How many at the table, open 👪 Family favorites, then Clear the week. Look at 💬 Text it — don’t send.

explore.name: 🧺 Shopping
explore.try: Tick some things. Add “milk” and “paper towels”. Try 🏠 Have it, Need it and Untick all. Look at 🖨 Print and 💬 Text — don’t send.

explore.name: 🟩 Helper card & Level
explore.find: The green card and the Level line at the top.
explore.try: Tap the green card’s button. Change the Level to 1, 2 and 3 and see what comes and goes.

explore.name: 🏠 Start menu · Plan a meal
explore.find: Tap the round ?, then 🏠 Start menu.
explore.try: Tap Plan a meal: pick a day, a kind of dinner, then a recipe. Check it is on This week.

explore.name: ❓ The round ? button
explore.find: Tap the round ? in the bottom corner.
explore.try: Open every line in it: Aa (size), ✨ Ask an AI, 🌉 More from Daraja, 🎬 Take the tour again. Close it. Leave “Start fresh” for the very end.
